additional_info.subject: RE: ID0470139-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/S1 313508370009] Issue with connector 1 CRM:02889000983
additional_info.body:
Buonasera Rosita,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0470139.
I am following up the analysis provided by my colleague, and these are my findings:
The first session started at 2026-01-02T18:17:03 and failed at 2026-01-02T18:19:41 during Authentication phase. The reason of this session to fail is that the RemoteStartTransaction arrived too late, when the authentication phase was already over.
The subsequent #3 sessions on DC1 they all failed during P03_CableCheck, for the same reason. During CableCheck, the charger commands the Outgoing Coils QA21-22 to close in order to raise the voltage across the power cable.  The session failed because the contactors QA21-22 did not close.
When the client connected to DC2, the session were successful because the charger uses different outgoing coils.
The issue was the generated by the contactors QA21-22 not closing. Usually, this error can have two root-causes:
The contactors QA21-22 are actually defective, and can never close
The state Monitor is not actually commanding the contactors to close. A reboot restore the correct functioning.
I had a look at the behavior of DC1 over the last week, and these are my findings:
No reboots were done in the past week.
The Abnormal Fbk of the contactors happened only for #3 days, from 02.01.2026 until 04.01.2026. After that, several sessions were performed on DC1, and no issue appeared anymore.
IN conclusion, I believe that the event was caused by the contactors being temporarily stuck, and not working for a couple of days.
If you agree, I would suggest to keep this ticket opened until next week, so that I can monitor the behavior of the contactors over the weekend.
If no further issue will appear on QA21-22, I will proceed to close the ticket. If further issues will appear, I will redirect the ticket to the RC-IT colleagues for corrective measures.
Looking forward to hearing form you soon!
With kind regards,

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0470139-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/S1 313508370009] Issue with connector 1 CRM:02889000983
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
I am following up on ticket
ID0470139.
I checked the charger today to see if the missing FBk on contactors QA21-22 appeared again over the weekend.
Since last Thursday 08.01.2025, the error did not occur anymore. Outlet DC1 was available to charge and no session was not initiated due to the error.
I would assume therefore that it was a temporary error due to the contactors being temporarily not responding. A reboot at the time made the contactor move and the issue has disappeared.
Since the issue can be considered solved, I will proceed to close this ticket, thank you!
